posts.title: What happened to blockchain
posts.description: Remember blockchain? Remember crypto? I remember. Twelve lines of solidity and a jankass WebGPU client later, I have a global multiplayer minecraft server. Want to play?

posts.title: A Cavalcade of the Olfactory Dimension
posts.description: We have all been there, at least once in life. The door opens and a special kind of odor slinks its way up your nose. The gym.

posts.title: how to be authentic
posts.description: Eating fast food is like tasting the spirit of authenticity. This is the analogy that comes to mind when I try to understand why I have such admiration for and disgust with mainstream pop, hip-hop, and rap music.
